description: Source code for AuthService class implementing user authentication functionalities including registration, login, token verification, and fetching user data. Utilizes FastAPI, JWT, and Supabase client integrations.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Handles user registration, login, token generation and validation, and fetching user info.

methods.name: AuthResponse register(self, user_data: UserCreate)
methods.description: Registers a new user, creates user profile, and returns authentication response with token.

methods.name: AuthResponse login(self, credentials: UserLogin)
methods.description: Auths the user with email and password, fetches profile, and returns JWT token with user info.

methods.name: Optional[UserResponse] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves user profile by user ID from the database.

methods.name: str _create_access_token(self, user_id: str, email: str, role: UserRole)
methods.description: Generates JWT token containing user ID, email, and role.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] verify_token(self, token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates JWT token, returning payload or raising an exception.

ctags.name: _create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^    def _create_access_token(self, user_id: str, email: str, role: UserRole) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (self, user_id: str, email: str, role: UserRole)

ctags.name: get_user_by_id
ctags.pattern: /^    async def get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str) -> Optional[UserResponse]:$/

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^    async def login(self, credentials: UserLogin) -> AuthResponse:$/

ctags.name: register
ctags.pattern: /^    async def register(self, user_data: UserCreate) -> AuthResponse:$/

ctags.name: verify_token
ctags.pattern: /^    def verify_token(self, token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
